editorial_review.coverage: All 45 selected entries, 140 entry units and 13 supporting units reviewed internally against retained observations; three Important and one Minor editorial findings corrected.
editorial_review.limitations: Not an independent re-fetch of the 83 retained source records, not current-market or medical certification. Community quotes are attributed experiences, not proven opinions. Local release approval is not a live deployment assertion.
